title: "Memories" - 256 byte MSDOS intro
summary: Memories is a 256-byte MS-DOS demo that packs eight effects and MIDI soundscapes into a tiny program. It won first place at Revision 2020.
why: HN people share it as a mind-blowing example of demoscene craft and the reigning champion of 256-byte demos.

quote.text: producing stuff that is just as mindblowing as it was when it all began.
